text: **Hint 1:** Consider how LASSO regularization affects the complexity of the model. LASSO tends to shrink some coefficients to zero, effectively reducing the number of features used in the model. How might this reduction in complexity influence the model's variance?\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the relationship between model complexity and variance. A more complex model typically has higher variance because it can fit the training data very closely, including noise. How does LASSO regularization, which reduces complexity, impact this relationship?
